newsitem.title: NEPAL: Earthquake rocks Nepal, no casualties reported.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake rocks Nepal, no casualties reported.

text.p: Nepal's Kathmandu valley was rocked by two earthquakes early on Saturday but there were no immediate reports of casualties, officials said.
The officials told Reuters a first tremor at 11 p.m. (1715 GMT) was followed by a second, stronger earthquake measuring 5.8 on the open-ended Richter scale at 1.45 a.m. (2000 GMT).
The officials said the epicentre was located in Rasuwa district, north-east of the capital Kathmandu.
Earthquakes between four and five on the Richter scale are powerful enough to cause heavy damage in populated areas.
"We felt the tremor when we were fast asleep," Kathmandu resident Sunil Sharma said. "I rushed to call my parents who were sleeping on the upper floor and we ran out of the house."
"Some houses developed cracks and windows were thrown off balance," a police official in Rasuwa town said, adding that no casualties had been reported so far.
